name: Eleanor Rigby
psychographics: Delegates the 'mental load' of home management; believes that if she can pay someone to do it, she should, so she can focus on creative work
current_solutions: Uses a local 'nanny-share' app for after-school care, orders groceries via Checkers Sixty60 (30-min delivery promise), uses a premium airport transfer service for work trips
frustration: Attempted to book a same-day dentist appointment for her toddler at 9am; the only available slot was at 4:30pm, which clashed with her partner's work finish time, and the clinic refused to move it
decision_style: Books the first available slot on the app, pays the premium fee for 'urgent care', and rarely reads the fine print
voice: Formal yet exhausted. Speaks in complete sentences with a weary sigh implied; uses South African English idioms like 'just now' meaning 'eventually'.
